raw:
@q query
  mode every
  where match
    relation "be enrolled at"
    role subject ?p
    role object "Academia de Muzică din Bistrița"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  scope match
    relation "be certified"
    role subject ?p
    polarity negated
  end
